en: But I thought about this this week, and so I just wanted to share some thoughts.
zh: 但我这周想到这件事了，所以就想分享一些想法。

en: I've sort of experienced many of the different living arrangements.
zh: 我算是经历过很多种不同的居住方式。

en: but I have been living alone for a while now.
zh: 但我已经独居有一段时间了。

en: I'm just realizing that it's kind of getting harder and harder.
zh: 我只是渐渐意识到，这好像变得越来越难了。

en: but also the thought of living with another person.
zh: 但与此同时，一想到要和另一个人一起住，

en: is also getting harder and harder.
zh: 也同样越来越难。

en: So I'm like, where does that leave me?
zh: 所以我就在想，那我到底该怎么办呢？

en: You know, one of the obvious pros of living alone is that.
zh: 你知道，独居一个很明显的好处就是，

en: it's not just this aesthetically beautiful situation.
zh: 它不只是表面上看起来很美很有氛围。

en: It is truly very calming.
zh: 它真的会让人非常平静。

en: You get to do everything uninterrupted.
zh: 你做任何事情都不会被打断。

en: You make your morning coffee.
zh: 你给自己煮早上的咖啡。

en: You sit in peace Read your book Think.
zh: 你安安静静地坐着，看书，思考。

en: Look outside the window.
zh: 看看窗外。

en: No one to be loud or no one to lose stuff or misplace things
zh: 没有人会吵闹，也没有人会把东西弄丢或乱放。

en: or there's just no one to blame for anything.
zh: 而且也根本没有人可以为任何事去责怪。

en: No one to get on your nerves.
zh: 没有人会惹你心烦。

en: No one to buy the wrong thing or to make a mess.
zh: 没有人会买错东西，也没有人会弄得一团糟。

en: Whatever the situation might be, it is just you and yourself.
zh: 不管是什么情况，都只有你和你自己。

en: and you get to decide what you want to watch, what you want to eat,
zh: 你可以自己决定想看什么、想吃什么，

en: what you want to listen to at what volume, when you want to go to bed,
zh: 想听什么、音量开多大，什么时候想睡觉，

en: when you want to wake up.
zh: 什么时候想起床。

en: You don't have to account for anyone else's life or schedule.
zh: 你不用去配合任何其他人的生活或作息。

en: But also, just like with everything in life, it's not a perfect situation.
zh: 但同时，就像生活中的很多事情一样，这也不是一种完美的状态。

en: There are some obvious downsides of the situation.
zh: 这种状态也有一些很明显的缺点。

en: It's a lot of small things, but it's also some bigger things.
zh: 有很多是一些小事，但也有一些是更大的问题。

en: Some of the small things are things like someone interrupting you in a pleasant way.
zh: 其中一些小事，比如说，有人以一种让人愉快的方式打断你。

en: So what could that be?
zh: 那会是什么样呢？

en: It could be someone sharing something that they saw or that they heard that day
zh: 可能是有人分享了他们那天看到的事，或者听到的事。

en: and suddenly you are talking about something that's quite interesting or.
zh: 然后你们突然就聊起了某个很有意思的话题，或者。

en: maybe you are learning something or.
zh: 也许你会因此学到点什么，或者。

en: maybe they can recommend you something that they read or something that they noticed on that day.
zh: 也许他们会推荐给你一些他们读到的东西，或者那天注意到的事情。

en: Or even a little background noise by another person.
zh: 甚至只是另一个人发出的一点点背景动静。

en: To an extent, obviously if it's someone that you like a lot,
zh: 当然，要在某种程度上来说，前提是那个人是你很喜欢的人，

en: can be quite nice.
zh: 这其实会挺不错的。

en: Just like hearing their little chores and whatever they are up to,
zh: 就像听着他们做点琐事，或者忙着自己的事情，

en: that interruption can be quite pleasant.
zh: 那种打断其实会让人觉得挺舒服。

en: Or maybe they can suggest what you guys can eat, what you guys can watch,
zh: 又或者，他们可以提议你们吃什么、看什么，

en: what you guys are going to do this weekend.
zh: 这个周末你们要做什么。

en: or they can give you an idea on something.
zh: 或者他们能在某件事上给你一个想法。

en: It creates for a fuller life in a way.
zh: 某种程度上，这会让生活更充实。

en: Then obviously the conveniences.
zh: 然后当然还有那些便利之处。

en: Like if I want a glass of water.
zh: 比如如果我想喝一杯水。

en: no one is going to bring me a glass of water.
zh: 没有人会给我端来一杯水。

en: If I'm really craving something.
zh: 如果我特别想吃点什么。

en: I have to go buy it myself.
zh: 我就得自己去买。

en: If I have a bit of an errand, but I have a cold,
zh: 如果我有点事情要办，但我感冒了，

en: I'm not feeling well.
zh: 身体不太舒服。

en: no one is going to do that errand for me.
zh: 也没有人会替我去办那件事。
